name: zk-attendance-web
description: Web version of the ZK Attendance Manager: React + Tailwind client, Node.js + TypeScript server, same SQL Server database

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.check: npm --prefix server run check && npm --prefix client run check
scripts.test:e2e: python test/e2e_api.py && python test/e2e_pi.py && python test/e2e_portal.py && python test/e2e_hr.py
